title: Police bust P7.8M smuggled cigarettes in Lanao del Sur

blocks.text: COTABATO CITY—Acting on a tip from concerned citizens, police confiscated P7.8 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes in Picong, Lanao del Sur, on Friday night, Nov. 13, police confirmed Sunday. Brig. Gen. Christopher Abecia, Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRO-BAR) regional director, said joint police operatives from the Picong Municipal Police Station and regional and provincial police mobile force units conducted the anti-smuggling operation in Barangay Mapantao, seizing 195 cases of suspected smuggled cigarettes. Earlier, police received intelligence information about unidentified men loading suspected smuggled cigarettes onto a cargo truck inside a warehouse in Barangay Mapantao.
